description: This file defines the NetworkFirewallClient class for interacting with AWS Network Firewall service, including method annotations for various firewall operations.

classes.name: NetworkFirewallClient
classes.description: Client class for AWS Network Firewall service, extending AwsClient, with method annotations for firewall management operations.

methods.name: associateFirewallPolicy
methods.description: Associates a firewall policy with a firewall.

methods.name: associateFirewallPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates a firewall policy with a firewall.

methods.name: describeFirewall
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specified firewall.

methods.name: describeFirewallAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a specified firewall.

methods.name: updateFirewallDescription
methods.description: Updates the description of a firewall.

methods.name: updateFirewallDescriptionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates the description of a firewall.
